Woolf born Jan 25, Joyce born Feb 2 — Woolf is 8 days older. Woolf died March 28, Joyce died Jan 13 — Woolf died 74 days later. Total 82 days. Correct.

The candidate answer matches the reference answer exactly: Woolf lived 82 days longer. The alias also says "Virginia Woolf, 82 days longer than James Joyce."

So verdict: correct.

Note the candidate answer's calculation: Woolf died March 28, 1941, Joyce died Jan 13, 1941. Jan 13 to March 28 = 18 days (rest of Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 28 (March) = 74. Yes. 8 + 74 = 82. Correct.
